`final class MsdfFont`<br/>
**Extends:** [`GlyphFont<MsdfFontFace>`](/reference/text/glyphfont/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfFont.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/MsdfFont.java)

A font drawn from multi-channel signed distance fields, sharp at every size, with one face per weight and style.

## Description

[`MsdfFontLoader`](/reference/text/msdffontloader/) creates it; pass it to [`TextInfo.create`](/reference/text/textinfo/#TextInfo-factory-create).
Its glyphs are drawn by [`MsdfTextRenderer`](/reference/text/msdftextrenderer/).

## Creation details

<a id="MsdfFont-factory-of"></a>

### of

`MsdfFont of(MsdfFontFace... faces)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates a font from faces that are already read.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when no face is given or when two faces share a weight and a style.
